papers.title: Semiotic Logical Hexagon Theory for LLM Logical Reasoning
papers.authors: Yunyao Zhang, Xinglang Zhang, Zeliang Chen, Junqing Yu, Zikai Song
papers.summary: Introduces HexLogicAgent and a logical-hexagon theory that explicitly organizes complete semantic opposition before deduction, improving reasoning reliability across multiple LLMs and logical benchmarks.

papers.title: Seeing Further and Wider: Joint Spatio-Temporal Enlargement for Micro-Video Popularity Prediction
papers.authors: Dali Wang, Yunyao Zhang, Junqing Yu, Yi-Ping Phoebe Chen, Chen Xu, Zikai Song
papers.summary: Jointly enlarges temporal video perception and spatial historical memory through highlight-aware frame scoring and a topology-aware memory bank for scalable micro-video popularity prediction.

papers.title: IntervenSim: Intervention-Aware Social Network Simulation for Opinion Dynamics
papers.authors: Yunyao Zhang, Zuocheng Ying, Xinglang Zhang, Junqing Yu, Peng Fang, Xu Chen, Wei Yang, Zikai Song
papers.summary: Models source-side interventions and crowd feedback in a closed loop, allowing social-network event trajectories and collective opinion dynamics to co-evolve under intervention.

papers.title: Coupling Macro Dynamics and Micro States for Long-Horizon Social Simulation
papers.authors: Yunyao Zhang, Yihao Ai, Zuocheng Ying, Qirui Mi, Junqing Yu, Wei Yang, Zikai Song
papers.summary: MF-MDP couples per-agent latent opinion states with mean-field collective dynamics, supporting stable long-horizon simulations and capturing gradual opinion reversals.

papers.title: Logical Phase Transitions: Understanding Collapse in LLM Logical Reasoning
papers.authors: Xinglang Zhang, Yunyao Zhang, Zeliang Chen, Junqing Yu, Wei Yang, Zikai Song
papers.summary: Identifies abrupt phase-transition boundaries in LLM logical reasoning and proposes neuro-symbolic curriculum tuning to mitigate collapse at high logical complexity.

papers.title: Semantic-Aware Logical Reasoning via a Semiotic Framework
papers.authors: Yunyao Zhang, Xinglang Zhang, Junxi Sheng, Wenbing Li, Junqing Yu, Yi-Ping Phoebe Chen, Wei Yang, Zikai Song
papers.summary: LogicAgent uses the semiotic square for multi-perspective semantic analysis, automated deduction, and reflective verification, and introduces the RepublicQA logical-reasoning benchmark.

papers.title: GA-S³: Comprehensive Social Network Simulation with Group Agents
papers.authors: Yunyao Zhang, Zikai Song, Hang Zhou, Wenfeng Ren, Yi-Ping Phoebe Chen, Junqing Yu, Wei Yang
papers.summary: Proposes group agents that represent populations with similar behaviors, enabling realistic large-scale social-network simulation with complex interactions at manageable computational cost.

papers.title: Too Good to Be Real: AI Synthetic Preference Misreads What Real Humans Reward
papers.authors: Xinglang Zhang, Yuanmeng Xiang, et al.
papers.summary: Studies the synthetic-real preference gap through ontology-based preference decomposition: synthetic preferences overvalue explicit reasoning, while real platform users reward affective and expressive salience.
